title: 第二十一章 浑夕之鱼第二十二章 剡山赤铜
lines: 第二十一章：浑夕之鱼
冰井的寒气像无数根钢针，刺入骨髓。
两人顺着冰晶扶梯向下滑行，失重感持续了足足一分钟。当脚底终于触碰到实地时，巨大的冲击力让黄海涛骨折的左臂再次传来剧痛，他闷哼一声，单膝跪地。
这里不是地下，而是另一个世界。
没有冰雪，没有寒冷。眼前是一片无边无际的、浑浊的橙黄色海洋。天空是铅灰色的，低垂得仿佛触手可及，空气中弥漫着一股浓烈的、类似生锈铁钉和腐烂海藻混合的腥臭味。海浪拍打着黑色的玄武岩海岸，发出沉闷的“啪嗒”声，没有泡沫，只有粘稠的泥浆。
“浑夕之山……”李元茜挣扎着站起来，看着手中那张已经被汗水浸湿的《山海经》拓片，“《北山经》里说，‘又北五百里，曰浑夕之山，无草木，多铜玉。嚣水出焉，而西北流注于海。有蛇一首两身，名曰肥遗，见则其国大旱。’”
“肥遗？”黄海涛看向那片死气沉沉的海面，“那种两头蛇会出现在海里？”
“看那边！”李元茜指向远处的海平线。
在海天交接的地方，有一个巨大的、正在移动的黑点。随着距离拉近，两人看清了那是什么。
那是一座山。
一座漂浮在海面上的、由无数黑色礁石和枯骨堆积而成的移动岛屿。岛屿表面坑坑洼洼，布满了大大小小的孔洞，像一块巨大的瑞士奶酪。而在岛屿的最高点，矗立着一个巨大的、螺旋形的贝壳状结构，像是一个天然的扩音器，正对着天空，发出低沉的、有节奏的嗡鸣。
“那是……巢？”黄海涛眯起眼睛，“谁的巢？”
话音刚落，答案就揭晓了。
哗啦——！
从那个巨大的贝壳状结构中，猛地冲起一道巨大的水柱。那不是普通的水，而是粘稠的、如同石油般的黑色液体。水柱直冲云霄，在半空中炸开，化作一片黑色的雨幕，淋在周围的礁石上，发出“滋滋”的腐蚀声。
紧接着，一个庞然大物从贝壳巢穴中滑入海中。
那是浑夕之鱼。
它的体型堪比一艘驱逐舰，流线型的身体覆盖着一层厚厚的、像鳄鱼皮一样的角质鳞片。头部扁平，长着一张横向裂开的、像吸尘器口一样的巨嘴，嘴里没有牙齿，只有无数根长短不一的、如同触手般的肉须。最诡异的是它的眼睛——那不是一对，而是三对，呈倒三角形排列在头部两侧，每一只眼睛都散发着幽幽的绿光。
“三眼……这是变异的深海鮟鱇鱼？”李元茜快速翻动着脑海中的生物图鉴，“但它怎么可能在海面上活动？”
“因为它不是鱼。”一个虚弱的声音从两人背后的礁石堆里传来。
两人猛地转身。
在嶙峋的黑色礁石缝隙中，蜷缩着一个身影。他衣衫褴褛，满身油污，但那张脸，两人再熟悉不过。
是陈宇。
但他已经不是那个意气风发的科考队长了。他的头发胡子拉碴，眼神涣散，左手小臂不自然地扭曲着，显然骨折了。最可怕的是他的皮肤，呈现出一种病态的灰黄色，上面布满了细小的、像鳞片一样的角质化斑块。
“陈宇！”李元茜冲过去，“你怎么会在这里？”
陈宇抬起头，那双浑浊的眼睛里闪过一丝疯狂的光芒。他看着两人，突然咧嘴笑了，露出一口发黄的牙齿。
“元茜……黄海涛……”他的声音沙哑得像破锣，“你们终于……追上我了。”
他挣扎着坐起来，指着那片漂浮的骨岛。
“那是‘浑夕之舟’。”他痴迷地说道，“是史前文明的‘清道夫’。它净化海水，吃掉所有的污染物和变异生物。这个世界的海洋本来是干净的，是后来……被‘污染’了。”
“什么污染？”黄海涛警惕地问，手里紧紧攥着石矛。
“门。”陈宇的眼神变得狂热，“那个‘北岳之门’。它不是一个门，它是一个‘泵’。它在把未来的……‘垃圾’，抽到过去来。那些变异的生物，那些有毒的化学物质，都是从未来被抽过来的！”
他指着自己身上的鳞片：“看！这是进化的证明！适应了污染环境的超级人类！我们不需要氧气，不需要干净的水，我们能在任何地方生存！”
“你疯了！”李元茜难以置信地看着他，“那是病变！是畸变！你在自我毁灭！”
“不，是升华！”陈宇猛地站起来，尽管左臂骨折，但他依然用右手从怀里掏出一个奇怪的装置——那是一个用各种零件拼凑起来的控制器，上面连着几根导线，一直延伸到礁石下的海水里。
“我已经控制了‘浑夕之鱼’。”陈宇狞笑着，按下了控制器上的一个按钮，“它现在，是我的坐骑。我要骑着它，去关掉那个‘泵’。但我需要一个祭品……来启动它的最终形态。”
他看向两人，眼神里充满了贪婪和疯狂。

Chapter 21: The Fish of Hunxi
1.
The cold air in the ice well is like countless steel needles, piercing into the bone marrow.
The two of them slid down the ice crystal escalator, feeling weightless for a full minute. When the soles of his feet finally touched the ground, the huge impact caused severe pain in Huang Haitao's fractured left arm again. He groaned and knelt down on one knee.
This is not the underground, but another world.
No ice or snow, no cold. In front of me is an endless, turbid orange-yellow ocean. The sky was leaden gray, hanging so low that it seemed you could touch it, and the air was filled with a strong stench that resembled a mixture of rusty iron nails and rotten seaweed. The waves crashed against the black basalt coast, making a dull "snap" sound. There was no foam, just sticky mud.
"The Mountain of Hunxi..." Li Yuanqian struggled to stand up and looked at the rubbing of the Book of Mountains and Seas that had been soaked with sweat in her hand. "The Book of Northern Mountains says, 'Five hundred miles to the north, it is called the Mountain of Hunxi. There is no vegetation, but a lot of copper and jade. The roaring water comes out, and flows northwest into the sea. There is a snake with two bodies, called Feiyi. When you see it, it means a severe drought in the country.'"
"Fat Yi?" Huang Haitao looked at the lifeless sea, "Will that kind of two-headed snake appear in the sea?"
"Look over there!" Li Yuanqian pointed to the horizon in the distance.
Where the sea meets the sky, there is a huge, moving black spot. As the distance got closer, the two of them saw clearly what it was.
That's a mountain.
A mobile island floating on the sea, made up of countless black rocks and dead bones. The surface of the island is pitted with holes, large and small, like a giant piece of Swiss cheese. At the highest point of the island, there stands a huge, spiral shell-like structure, like a natural loudspeaker, facing the sky, emitting a low, rhythmic buzz.
"That's...a nest?" Huang Haitao narrowed his eyes, "Whose nest is it?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the answer was revealed.
Wow——!
From the huge shell-like structure, a huge water column suddenly rushed up. It was not ordinary water, but a thick, petroleum-like black liquid. The water column shot straight into the sky, exploded in mid-air, and turned into a black rain curtain, showering on the surrounding rocks and making a "sizzling" corrosive sound.
Immediately afterwards, a huge creature slid into the sea from the shell nest.
That is the fish of Hunxi.
It is as big as a destroyer, and its streamlined body is covered with a thick layer of horny scales like crocodile skin. The head is flat, with a huge mouth that is split horizontally, like the mouth of a vacuum cleaner. There are no teeth in the mouth, only countless tentacle-like tendrils of different lengths. The weirdest thing is its eyes - there are not one pair, but three pairs, arranged in an inverted triangle shape on both sides of the head, each eye emitting a faint green light.
"Three eyes... Is this a mutated deep-sea anglerfish?" Li Yuanqian quickly flipped through the biological illustration in her mind, "But how can it move on the sea surface?"
"Because it's not a fish." A weak voice came from the rocks behind the two of them.
The two turned around sharply.
In the cracks of the rugged black reef, a figure huddled. His clothes were ragged and covered in oil, but that face was very familiar to both of them.
It's Chen Yu.
But he is no longer the high-spirited scientific expedition captain. His hair was unkempt, his eyes were unfocused, and his left forearm was twisted unnaturally, apparently broken. The most terrifying thing was that his skin was a sickly gray-yellow color, covered with small, scale-like keratinized patches.
"Chen Yu!" Li Yuanqian rushed over, "Why are you here?"
Chen Yu raised his head, a crazy light flashing in his cloudy eyes. He looked at the two of them and suddenly grinned, showing his yellowed teeth.
"Yuan Qian... Huang Haitao..." His voice was as hoarse as a broken gong, "You finally... caught up with me."
He struggled to sit up and pointed at the floating bone island.
"That is the 'Hunxi Boat'." He said obsessively, "It is the 'scavenger' of prehistoric civilization. It purifies the sea water and eats all pollutants and mutated organisms. The oceans of this world were originally clean, but later... they were 'polluted'."
"What kind of pollution?" Huang Haitao asked warily, holding the stone spear tightly in his hand.
"Gate." Chen Yu's eyes became fanatical, "That 'Beiyue Gate'. It is not a door, it is a 'pump'. It is pumping the future...'garbage' into the past. Those mutated creatures and those toxic chemicals are all pumped from the future!"
He pointed to the scales on his body: "Look! This is proof of evolution! Super humans who have adapted to the polluted environment! We don't need oxygen, we don't need clean water, we can survive anywhere!"
"You're crazy!" Li Yuanqian looked at him in disbelief, "That's a lesion! It's an aberration! You are destroying yourself!"
"No, it's sublimation!" Chen Yu stood up suddenly. Although his left arm was broken, he still took out a strange device from his arms with his right hand - it was a controller made of various parts, with several wires connected to it, extending all the way to the seawater under the reef.
"I have controlled the 'Fish of Hunxi'." Chen Yu smiled evilly and pressed a button on the controller. "It is now my mount. I want to ride it to turn off the 'pump'. But I need a sacrifice... to activate its final form."
He looked at the two of them, his eyes filled with greed and madness.
